pages.text: Transformer products — one base per mineral, the "mineral ID card":$(li)Coal / Iron / Copper Ore Bases$(li)Gold / Redstone / Lapis Ore Bases$(li)Diamond / Emerald Ore Bases$(li)Nether Quartz / Ancient Debris / Akaishi Ore Bases$(br2)These bases are the core materials for Catalyst tiers — without them, your crystal line stays stuck in the stone age.
